research_phases.title: Research baseline and work-structure recovery
research_phases.forward_method: Recover repository, authority, task, gate, stopped-loop, and next-action state before new theorem work.
research_phases.inverse_method: Recover anchor, holdout, target, map, and candidate-admission state from the same baseline.
research_phases.stop_or_redesign: Any authority, pointer, generated-surface, task, gate, or remote mismatch keeps both lanes in P0R.

research_phases.title: Evidence, observation, target, and holdout freeze
research_phases.forward_method: Freeze T-054 evidence roles, M0, candidate identities, hard discriminators, and owner-intake fields before model scoring.
research_phases.inverse_method: Freeze T-059 source editions and hashes, covariance or likelihood, lineage groups, effective QFT/YM/GR targets, and calibration/retrospective/prospective roles.
research_phases.stop_or_redesign: Target leakage, duplicate derived data, missing covariance, or post-disclosure mutation resets P1.

research_phases.title: Candidate model-owner and complete-map admission
research_phases.forward_method: Pin functional or action, reference, state, generator or transfer, projection, time boundary, regulator, normalization, finite parts, common norm, limit order, filtration, heat-root map, current intertwiner, and one-use ledger.
research_phases.inverse_method: Require complete F_reg, F_lim, F_eff, and F_obs stages with uncertainty and nuisance propagation for each candidate version.
research_phases.stop_or_redesign: A missing earlier owner or map stage yields NOT_ADMITTED; static data cannot fill a dynamics field.

research_phases.title: Fixed-scope theorem and inverse-existence package
research_phases.forward_method: Work through the five Sector-A theorem families under the selected candidate version with exact finite scope and primary, independent, hostile, and Lean dispositions.
research_phases.inverse_method: Test whether at least one admitted parameter member reproduces the frozen target at finite regulated scope.
research_phases.stop_or_redesign: A finite PASS cannot be extrapolated to uniform, continuum, physical, or empirical scope.

research_phases.title: Common core, uniformity, ordered limits, and stability
research_phases.forward_method: Prove common-core closure, one-use source control, uniform estimates, and the declared cutoff, volume, exhaustion, phase, beta, and regulator limit order.
research_phases.inverse_method: Perturb observation errors, nuisance assumptions, regulator, and map approximations and report set-valued stability rather than point uniqueness.
research_phases.stop_or_redesign: Failure of a uniform estimate retains only the finite tier and records the failure boundary.

research_phases.title: Physical sector, effective-theory identity, and quotient identifiability
research_phases.forward_method: Follow the pinned QFT bridge order through same-owner physical-empty comparison, OS reconstruction, spectrum and cone, gauge/YM, gravity, and physical-sector identification.
research_phases.inverse_method: Determine whether the effective target distinguishes a unique microscopic version or only an equivalence class under the declared quotient.
research_phases.stop_or_redesign: An analogy, naming match, or fitted low-energy parameter set is not physical identity.

research_phases.title: Prospective prediction
research_phases.forward_method: Freeze the candidate, owner, map, scorer, uncertainty budget, and prediction before target disclosure.
research_phases.inverse_method: Unseal exactly one unused prospective holdout and compare against M0 without retuning.
research_phases.stop_or_redesign: Any post-unseal parameter, candidate, proof-owner, map, or scorer tuning reclassifies the outcome as fitting.

research_phases.title: Gate synthesis and adversarial review
research_phases.forward_method: Audit the complete dependency and assumption crosswalk, all promotion boundaries, and all open scientific gates.
research_phases.inverse_method: Audit leakage, identifiability, stability, uncertainty, and prediction provenance across the full map.
